projects.title: Optimus Patient Alert System
projects.shortDescription: A wireless patient-to-care-team alert ecosystem connecting a bedside remote, room-side device, master receiver and service tooling.
projects.description: The system brings bedside alert initiation, local room indication, wireless event transfer and master-side notification into one coordinated product workflow. Development assets are organized across firmware, hardware, provisioning and client-ready release documentation.
projects.challenge: Create a dependable alert path across multiple device roles while keeping setup, service and release handling practical for deployment teams.
projects.solution: Structure the product as a coordinated remote, room-side and master-unit ecosystem, supported by controlled firmware packages and a dedicated provisioning workflow.
projects.outcome: A documented multi-device development package with product imagery, firmware releases, hardware assets, service tooling and handover material.

projects.title: Temperature & Humidity Controller
projects.shortDescription: An ESP32-based environmental controller combining temperature, humidity and dual-timer workflows through a DWIN touch interface.
projects.description: The controller combines environmental measurement, configurable set points, automatic operating modes and timed outputs in an enclosure-ready touch interface. Firmware, HMI and hardware references are maintained as separate but coordinated engineering packages.
projects.challenge: Present multiple control functions clearly on one operator interface while keeping sensor, timing and display communication logic maintainable.
projects.solution: Separate the firmware into focused modules for analog measurement, RTC, RS485, timers and HMI communication, then connect them through a structured application layer.
projects.outcome: A working controller prototype with an operator-focused display, modular firmware structure, hardware schematic reference and organized project documentation.
